# Voicemod sub-actions

## Get current voice

Finds out which voice Voicemod is using now and puts it into variables for later steps.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%voicemodVoiceName%` | The name of the current voice |
| `%voicemodVoiceId%` | The current voice's ID |

<small>Type id: `voicemod.getCurrentVoice`</small>

## Get sounds

Gets the list of your Voicemod soundboard sounds into variables for later steps.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%voicemodSounds%` | The sound names, separated by commas |
| `%voicemodSoundCount%` | How many sounds there are |
| `%voicemodSoundsJson%` | The full list with details, for people who use scripts |

<small>Type id: `voicemod.getSounds`</small>

## Get voices

Gets the list of your Voicemod voices into variables for later steps.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Only favorites** | Tick to list only the voices you starred as favorites in Voicemod. Untick to list them all. Starts as: `false`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%voicemodVoices%` | The voice names, separated by commas |
| `%voicemodVoiceCount%` | How many voices there are |
| `%voicemodVoicesJson%` | The full list with details, for people who use scripts |

<small>Type id: `voicemod.getVoices`</small>

## Play sound

Plays a sound from your Voicemod soundboard. Handy for a sound effect reward.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Sound (name)** | The sound's name as the Voicemod soundboard shows it. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%voicemodSoundName%` | The name of the sound that was played |

<small>Type id: `voicemod.playSound`</small>

## Select random voice

Switches Voicemod to a random voice. Fun for a surprise reward.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **From** | Which voices to pick from: AllVoices, FreeVoices (Voicemod's free voices), FavoriteVoices (the ones you starred in Voicemod) or CustomVoices (the ones you made). Options: AllVoices, FreeVoices, FavoriteVoices, CustomVoices. Starts as: `AllVoices`. |

<small>Type id: `voicemod.selectRandomVoice`</small>

## Select voice

Switches Voicemod to a voice of your choice. Handy as a reward, like a robot voice for a few minutes.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Voice (name or id)** | The voice's name as Voicemod shows it, like "Robot", or its ID. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%voicemodVoiceName%` | The name of the voice that was chosen |
| `%voicemodVoiceId%` | That voice's ID |

<small>Type id: `voicemod.selectVoice`</small>

## Set background effect state

Turns Voicemod's background sound effects on or off.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **State** | Toggle flips the current setting, On turns it on and Off turns it off. Options: Toggle, On, Off. Starts as: `Toggle`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%voicemodBackgroundEffects%` | True when background effects are on now |

<small>Type id: `voicemod.setBackgroundEffects`</small>

## Set censor beep

Turns Voicemod's censor beep, which bleeps out bad language, on or off.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Beep** | On turns the censor beep on. Off turns it off. Options: On, Off. Starts as: `On`. |

<small>Type id: `voicemod.setCensorBeep`</small>

## Set hear my voice state

Turns 'hear my voice' on or off, so you can listen to yourself in your headphones.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **State** | Toggle flips the current setting, On turns it on and Off turns it off. Options: Toggle, On, Off. Starts as: `Toggle`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%voicemodHearMyself%` | True when hearing yourself is on now |

<small>Type id: `voicemod.setHearMyself`</small>

## Set microphone mute state

Mutes or unmutes your microphone in Voicemod.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Muted** | Toggle flips the current setting, On mutes the microphone and Off unmutes it. Options: Toggle, On, Off. Starts as: `Toggle`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%voicemodMuted%` | True when the microphone is muted now |

<small>Type id: `voicemod.setMute`</small>

## Set voice changer state

Turns the Voicemod voice changer on or off.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **State** | Toggle flips the current setting, On turns it on and Off turns it off. Options: Toggle, On, Off. Starts as: `Toggle`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%voicemodVoiceChanger%` | True when the voice changer is on now |

<small>Type id: `voicemod.setVoiceChanger`</small>

## Stop all sounds

Stops every Voicemod soundboard sound that is playing.

<small>Type id: `voicemod.stopAllSounds`</small>
